remarks: Turnkey multifamily investment opportunity at 76 Meadow Place! This fully updated 2/2 duplex features two spacious 2-bedroom apartments and is ready to add to your investment portfolio with minimal upfront work. Both units are equipped with HVAC for added tenant comfort and convenience. Laundry hook ups in basement. The property also features plenty of off-street parking and a private yard, providing desirable amenities for current and future tenants. Ideally located with convenient access to Buffalo Niagara International Airport, the NYS Thruway, shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and everyday amenities, 76 Meadow Place offers a great combination of location, condition, and investment potential. For an even stronger investment opportunity, 76 Meadow Place adjoins 80 Meadow Place, a fully updated triplex located on a separate lot. The owner prefers to sell the properties as a package, offering investors the rare opportunity to acquire 5 turnkey units across two adjoining parcels without commercial lending. An excellent portfolio addition with multiple income streams and long-term investment potential. Open House 8/30/26 from 11am-1pm
